meta.title: CNC STUDIO | Precision CNC Machining — 5-Axis Milling · Mill-Turn · Wire EDM
meta.desc: CNC Studio — precision CNC machining workshop specializing in 5-axis milling, mill-turn, and wire EDM. ±0.005mm tolerance serving aerospace, medical devices, and precision instruments.
hero.desc: Founded in 2011, CNC Studio is a technology-driven workshop specializing in high-precision CNC machining. With a tolerance standard of ±0.005mm, we provide reliable component manufacturing for aerospace, medical devices, precision instruments, semiconductors, and beyond. From prototyping to batch production — every piece is backed by data.
services.label: Services
services.title: One-Stop Precision Manufacturing
services.desc: A full process chain covering milling, turning, EDM, surface treatment, and quality inspection — from single-piece prototyping to volume production.
services.s1.name: CNC Milling
services.s1.desc: 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis CNC milling for aluminum alloys, titanium, stainless steel, engineering plastics, and more. Complex surfaces and high-precision structural parts.
services.s2.name: CNC Turning
services.s2.desc: Precision CNC lathe machining with mill-turn capability. Ideal for shafts, discs, and sleeve parts with excellent batch consistency.
services.s3.name: Wire EDM
services.s3.desc: Slow-wire EDM and sinker EDM for ultra-hard materials and complex internal cavities — achieving micron-level precision.
services.s4.name: Surface Treatment
services.s4.desc: Full range of surface finishing: anodizing, electroplating, sandblasting, passivation, black oxide — parts that meet standards inside and out.
services.s5.name: Quality Inspection
services.s5.desc: CMM, vision measurement, roughness testing — every part ships with a full dimensional inspection report. Data is transparent and traceable.
services.s6.name: Engineering Consulting
services.s6.desc: DFM analysis, process optimization, material selection — we don't just machine parts; we help you get the design right from the start.
equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.title: Advanced CNC Machines · Precision Guaranteed
equipment.desc: Equipped with imported 5-axis machining centers, mill-turn machines, wire EDM, and full inspection instruments — a complete process chain from roughing to finishing.
equipment.e1.title: 5-Axis Machining Center
equipment.e1.desc: Imported 5-axis centers for complex surfaces in a single setup — eliminating cumulative error from multiple fixturing.
equipment.e2.title: Mill-Turn Center
equipment.e2.desc: Integrated turning and milling in one setup, reducing process transfers and improving concentricity and efficiency.
equipment.e3.title: Slow-Wire EDM
equipment.e3.desc: Micron-level wire EDM precision for hardened steels, carbide, and other ultra-hard materials.
equipment.e4.title: CMM (Coordinate Measuring)
equipment.e4.desc: Fully automatic CMM for micron-level dimensional verification — every part meets design tolerance.

process.label: Our Process
process.title: 6-Step Quality · Precision Manufacturing
process.desc: From drawing review to finished delivery, every step follows rigorous standards. Great craftsmanship comes from process control, not just equipment.
process.step1.title: Drawing Review
process.step1.desc: Engineers perform DFM analysis — evaluating tolerance feasibility, machinability, and providing optimization recommendations.
process.step2.title: Process Planning
process.step2.desc: Design machining strategy, select tools and cutting parameters, generate and simulate CAM toolpaths.
process.step3.title: Rough Machining
process.step3.desc: Rapid bulk material removal with finishing allowance, controlling workpiece deformation and internal stress.
process.step4.title: Finish Machining
process.step4.desc: High-precision cutting to final dimensions, strictly controlling surface finish and geometric tolerances.
process.step5.title: Quality Inspection
process.step5.desc: CMM full-dimensional measurement + roughness testing + visual inspection. FAI report issued for every part.
process.step6.title: Cleaning & Packaging
process.step6.desc: Ultrasonic cleaning to remove oil and debris, anti-rust treatment, then vacuum-sealed packaging for damage-free transport.
